title.narrative: Provision of Integrated Nutrition and WASH assistance to conflict affected persons in Banki, Bama Local Government Area, Borno State.

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gtFHI 360 is proposing to expand the coverage and capacity of SAM treatment services in Banki, lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gtin the lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gtBama LGA of Borno state. lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gtThe lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gtFHI 360 established Stabilization Centre (SC) in Banki will be expanded to 25 beds from the current 11 bed capacity. FHI 360 will provide medical and nutritional management of SAM cases with complications, provide three nutritious meals for caregivers of SAM children at the SC to reduce defaulter rates lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gtand conductlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gt routine mortality audits/reviews. Similarly, FHI 360 will establish a mobilelt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gt outpatient therapeutic programme lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gtOTP center in Wajare to improve coverage and better manage SAM cases without medical complications among children 6-59 months lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gtand link lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gtMAM cases with existing treatment services by FHI 360 and other partners. lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp style="margin-bottom:0inline-height:normal" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:"gtTo reverse the suboptimal IYCF Practices, the project will provide Maternal Infant and Young Child Feeding (MIYCF) services through the social and behavioral change communication strategy. The project will provide skilled counselling at all service delivery points and establish 100 Community Support Groups (CSG) across the selected communities. Trained Community Health Workers (CHWs) will coordinate their activities and will deliver behavior change interventions using the National Counselling Cards.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="color: black font-family:"gtThe project intends to screen 16,000 children under five using healthcare workers, treat 630 SAM cases with and without complications, and directly target 2880 individuals with IYCF messaging to improve nutritional outcomes.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp style="margin-bottom:0inline-height:normal" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:"gtFHI 360 intends to deliver a WASH minimum package to the SAM admitted in Stabilization Centers and improve the WASH access at household and community level for IDPs, returnees and host communities. FHI 360 will provide support to Nutrition Stabilization centers managing SAM cases and follow up WASH support to affected households with hygiene promotion and other relevant WASH assistance. The project will target 15000 individuals in Banki where FHI 360 will be responding to SAM cases at stabilization centers supported by FHI 360 thereby having a multi-sectoral approach to addressing severe acute malnutrition. FHI 360 will optimize water supply access at the stabilization centers as well as support affected households to monitor and treat their drinking water at the point of use to reduce co-morbidities that may worsen the situation for SAM patients. In Banki, FHI 360 will contribute to the achievement of open defecation free status of nutrition facilities and hotspot communities through sanitation activities targeted at safe excreta disposal. FHI 360 will support latrine dislodgement as needed to empty emergency latrines where they are filled up especially at stabilization centers admitting SAM patients. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp style="margin-bottom:0inline-height:normal" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:"gtThe project will also address the gap in access to hygiene kits through supporting SAM-caregivers couples admitted to stabilization centers. SAM patients are among the most vulnerable groups requiring improved access to hygiene promotion information and hygiene kits. New arrivals will be targeted with general NFI support to cover the needs of vulnerable households especially new arrivals. Menstrual Hygiene management kits will be part of the NFI kit to cater for the menstrual hygiene of women and adolescent girls. Hygiene promoters will be recruited to disseminate hygiene awareness messaging including promotion knowledge on critical handwashing times.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp style="margin-bottom:0inline-height:normal" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:"gtFHI 360 will work with community-based hygiene promoters to disseminate hygiene messages to SAM caregivers at the stabilization centers as well as conduct household follow ups to identify WASH gaps and provide relevant assistance to the affected household including distribution of standard hygiene kits and replenishment kits as needed.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp style="margin-bottom:0inline-height:normal" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:"gtIn host communities, such as Wajare, where FHI 360 will set up a nutrition facility, emergency sanitation facilities will be installed, and water supply connected to maintain improved conditions for care for SAM patients after discharge from the stabilization centers.lt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="sceditor-nlf"gtltbrgtlt/pgt
